Report mdim-VRT metadata sufficiency of a STAC item

Source: R/vrtstack-core.R
stac_sufficiency.Rd

The emitter's requirements expressed as a checklist over one already-parsed STAC item (as from jsonlite::fromJSON(..., simplifyVector = FALSE)). No HTTP is performed here; fetching items is an adapter's job.

Usage

stac_sufficiency(item, asset = NULL)

Arguments

item

A parsed STAC item (a list).

asset

Optional asset key; when supplied, asset-level fields take precedence over item-level properties.

Value

A data frame with one row per checked field: field, found_at (one of "item-properties", "asset", "absent"), and a short value_preview.

Details

proj:epsg versus proj:code is a proj-extension version marker, not a gap: either satisfies the CRS requirement. datetime may be null for interval items, with start_datetime/end_datetime carrying the extent.
